items.title: Maye overcomes his two turnovers with 3 TD passes in Patriots' 29-26 win over Bills
items.summary: — Drake Maye threw three touchdown passes, including Efton Chism’s one-handed catch with 1:50 remaining, and the New England Patriots defeated the Buffalo Bills 29-26 on Sunday.

items.title: Rams rally behind Stafford, Williams from 10 points down in 4th quarter to beat Eagles 24-20
items.summary: — Kyren Williams ran for two touchdowns in the final four minutes as Matthew Stafford and the Los Angeles Rams rallied from a 10-point deficit to beat the Philadelphia Eagles 24-20 on Sunday.

items.title: CeeDee Lamb’s late TD caps a wild Cowboys rally to beat winless Texans 34-30
items.summary: — CeeDee Lamb had a career-high 17 catches for 189 yards and his 12-yard TD reception with 40 seconds left lifted the Dallas Cowboys to a 34-30 win over Houston on Sunday to keep the Texans winless.

items.title: Trevor Lawrence finally gets 1st win over Bengals as Jaguars hold on for 22-17 victory
items.summary: — Trevor Lawrence passed for 227 yards and a touchdown, Jacksonville's defense forced two critical turnovers and the Jaguars held off the Cincinnati Bengals 22-17 on Sunday.

items.title: Winston throws 3 TD passes and Banks' pick-6 seals Giants' 36-24 win over Cardinals
items.summary: — Jameis Winston showed off the good, bad and ugly of his football career and it required another late defensive stand to get it done. It was far from a masterpiece, but the New York Giants will take it.

items.title: Ravens beat Titans 24-18 despite Lamar Jackson's ankle injury. Henry scores against his old team
items.summary: — Lamer Jackson threw for 222 yards and two touchdowns before leaving the game with an ankle injury, Derrick Henry scored against his former team, and the Baltimore Ravens handled the Tennessee Titans 24-18 on Sunday.

items.title: Kyle Monangai scores 2 TDs as the Chicago Bears beat the New York Jets 23-12
